---
title: "Teaching"
---

I have taught mathematics at university level for more than twenty years, at undergraduate, master's, and doctoral level. My teaching has covered a broad range of subjects, including algebra, topology, geometry, and discrete mathematics.

## Current teaching

In autumn 2026 I am teaching **MAT221 Discrete Mathematics** at the University of Bergen.

The course covers topics including relations, combinatorics, elementary number theory, congruences, graph theory, and related discrete structures.

## Teaching materials

I develop teaching material alongside my courses, including lecture notes, exercises, and problem sheets. Where appropriate, I plan to make selected material available from this site.

## Supervision

I have supervised **nine completed master's students** and **three completed PhD students**.

Of the PhD students, I was **main supervisor for two** and **co-supervisor for one**.

My supervision has included projects in algebraic topology, topological data analysis, and related areas.

## International teaching and collaboration

I have also taught outside Norway. In October and November 2023 I gave lectures on **differential topology** at the University of Dar es Salaam in Tanzania.

Through the MATH4SDG collaboration I co-supervised a Tanzanian PhD student, and I continue to collaborate with colleagues at the University of Dar es Salaam on topological data analysis.
